frozen_evidence_boundary: restore-related source needed to establish that recovery machinery exists
no issues, discussions, PRs or bug history before Phase B/C freeze
raw_signal_observation: Reset-workspace copy says resetting deletes all pages/data and offers contacting support to restore the workspace. The visible workspace-error UI currently exposes logout only; the bloc contains a restoreFromSnapshot state while snapshot loading is commented out and the screen listener's restore branch is inert. Lower-level restore machinery exists elsewhere in the repository.
material_claim: Static source can establish the recovery promise and partial recovery machinery, but cannot establish whether the current operational/support path can reliably restore a reset workspace or under which prerequisites. Removing or strengthening the promise from source topology alone would outrun the authority available.
neta_next_move: Run a disposable workspace recovery drill through the support/backend path that the product promise refers to. Record prerequisites, success/failure and what data survives; then calibrate the copy to the demonstrated operational capability.
reversal_condition: If the support/environment drill cannot restore a reset workspace under the advertised conditions, qualify or remove the recovery promise; if it can, retain the promise and state any material prerequisites rather than inferring failure from unwired local UI.
baseline_decision: BUILD: qualify or remove the support-restore promise now because the visible restore-from-snapshot UI path is not wired and destructive copy should not promise recovery that source cannot demonstrate end-to-end.

evidence: Post-freeze issue #7872 documents users perceiving data loss after AppFlowy 0.9.0 created a different data directory.
An AppFlowy maintainer replied: `As long as you have these data folders, your data is safe and can be recovered.`

One user documented a reproducible multi-step recovery path; other users reported that recovery attempts failed, showing operational prerequisites/variability rather than proving either universal recoverability or absence of recovery capability.
adjudication.decision_delta: Neta prevented a source-only removal of a recovery promise that maintainers operationally support under conditions, while also refusing to assert universal recoverability. The remaining question correctly belongs to an environment/support recovery drill.
adjudication.lesson: Operational promises require operational evidence. Visible UI reachability can neither prove nor disprove a support/backend recovery capability.
